title: kb_http.py: stateless POST /mcp over kb_mcp.handle
goal: _tools/kb_http.py runs a stdlib ThreadingHTTPServer on 127.0.0.1 (--port, default 8080) whose POST /mcp passes each JSON-RPC message to kb_mcp.handle and returns application/json, 202 for a notification, 405 for GET and DELETE, never mints or echoes Mcp-Session-Id, and answers both the legacy initialize and the 2026-07-28 server/discover handshakes
